blocks.text: Kris Aquino once again underscored her determination to stay alive, saying she continues to draw strength from her family and place her trust in her medical team amid her ongoing health battle. The Queen of All Media said this as she gave an update on the current remodeling of their home in Tarlac, through her Instagram page on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
